title: A｜正常完成预订
setting: 你正在给 Grand Park Hotel 打电话，希望预订一间双人房。你需要说明入住日期、确认房型和价格，并留下预订姓名。
learningGoals: a double room / a single room

turns.text: Good afternoon, Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己要预订房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to book a room, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to book a room, please.
feedback.explanation: I’d like to... 是向酒店提出需求时常用的礼貌表达；book a room 表示预订房间，句末加 please 更自然。

choices.text: Hi, I want to make a reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to make a reservation, please.
feedback.explanation: make a reservation 搭配正确。I want to 语气较直接；对服务人员说 I’d like to... 通常更礼貌。

choices.text: Hi, I want book a room.

feedback.assessment: 意思清楚，但语法不完整
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I want to book a room.
feedback.explanation: want 后面接另一个动词时需要使用 want to + 动词原形，因此不能省略 to。

choices.text: Can you bring me some towels?

feedback.assessment: 表达本身正确，但不符合当前情景
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to book a room, please.
feedback.explanation: Can you bring me some towels? 是入住后向酒店索要毛巾，不是在电话中开始预订房间的表达。

turns.text: Of course. What dates will you be staying with us?

turns.prompt: 你计划从 10 月 12 日住到 10 月 14 日，会怎么说明？

choices.text: From October 12th to October 14th.

feedback.naturalExpression: From October 12th to October 14th.
feedback.explanation: 酒店已经询问 dates，因此直接用 from... to... 回答起止日期非常自然。

choices.text: I’ll be staying for two nights, from October 12th.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll be staying for two nights, from October 12th.
feedback.explanation: for two nights 说明住宿时长，from October 12th 说明起始日期，酒店可以据此确定退房日期。

choices.text: I stay October 12th to October 14th.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但表达不够自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll be staying from October 12th to October 14th.
feedback.explanation: 谈论已经计划好的住宿可用 I’ll be staying；日期范围前应保留 from，与 to 构成 from... to...。

choices.text: I’m staying two people.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ll be staying for two nights, from October 12th.
feedback.explanation: two people 表示人数，但前台问的是入住日期。说明人数可以说 There will be two of us。

turns.text: And what kind of room would you like?

turns.prompt: 你想预订一间双人房，会怎么回答？

choices.text: I’d like a double room, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like a double room, please.
feedback.explanation: a double room 通常指带一张双人床、供两人入住的房间；I’d like... 很适合说明房型偏好。

choices.text: Do you have a double room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a double room available?
feedback.explanation: Do you have... available? 用来询问某种房型是否还有空房，是电话预订中的高频句型。

choices.text: I want a room with one large bed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like a double room, please.
feedback.explanation: 前台能够理解 one large bed，不过直接使用房型名称 a double room 更简洁；I’d like 也比 I want 更礼貌。

choices.text: I’d like a double rooms.

feedback.assessment: 冠词和名词数量不一致
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like a double room.
feedback.explanation: a 表示一个，后面的可数名词应使用单数 room，不能说 a... rooms。

turns.text: Yes, we do. It’ll be $120 per night, including breakfast.

turns.prompt: 你接受每晚 120 美元并包含早餐的价格，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds good. I’ll take it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: That sounds good 表示你认可这个安排；I’ll take it 用来确认接受房型和价格。

choices.text: Great. I’d like to book it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’d like to book it.
feedback.explanation: it 指前台刚刚介绍的双人房；这句话明确表示希望按当前条件完成预订。

choices.text: Okay, I take it.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但时态不自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: 当场作出接受决定时，英语通常使用 I’ll take it，而不是一般现在时 I take it。

choices.text: How much nights?

feedback.assessment: 问题与当前信息不匹配
feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: nights 是可数名词，应搭配 how many；而入住晚数已经确定，此时应该确认是否接受价格。

turns.text: Certainly. May I have your name, please?

turns.prompt: 前台询问预订姓名，你会怎么回答？

choices.text: Sure. It’s Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 在电话中提供姓名时，It’s... 是自然常用的回答方式。

choices.text: The reservation will be under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: The reservation will be under the name Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: a reservation under a name 表示以某个姓名登记的预订；补充 under the name... 会更加完整。

choices.text: My name are Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: My name is Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 主语 My name 是单数，因此 be 动词应使用 is，不能使用 are。

turns.text: Thank you, Miss/Mr. Chen. Your room is booked for October 12th to October 14th. We look forward to seeing you.

turns.prompt: 预订已经完成，你会怎样结束通话？

choices.text: Thank you. See you then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. See you then.
feedback.explanation: 先感谢前台，再用 See you then 表示到约定日期见，是简洁自然的结束方式。

choices.text: Great, thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: thanks for your help 很适合在服务人员帮助完成预订后表达感谢。

choices.text: You’re welcome.

feedback.assessment: 语法正确，但不适合这样结束预订
feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. See you then.
feedback.explanation: You’re welcome 通常用于回应别人对你的感谢。这里前台为你完成了预订，作为客人主动道谢并告别更符合语境。
